# Keeping the Light

*Ysolde's knees will not manage the hundred and seventeen stairs tonight. She asks you to keep the light, and to watch the water past the headland from the Holm Wood's cliff edge.*

## Objectives

1. Defeat 50 [Dusk Wolf](../monsters/dusk_wolf.md) in [The Timber Path](../maps/timber_path.md)
2. Look at the lighthouse's view over the Drop in [The Cliff Edge](../maps/cliff_edge.md)
3. Bring 15 [Dusk Wolf Pelt](../items/dusk_wolf_pelt.md) (taken)

## Rewards

- 55,056 EXP
- 1,650 mesos
- +60 standing with [Ysolde](../npcs/ysolde.md)
- +25 standing with Bain Harbour
